IMPORTSCOPE / OFFLINE EVALUATION KIT

1. Extract this ZIP into one folder.
2. Open index.html in a modern desktop browser. Keep the other files beside it.
3. The page opens with an explicitly labeled example comparison.
4. Choose a current Shopify product export and the product CSV you plan to import.
5. Review findings and download the full HTML report. Open the report and use
   your browser's Print / Save as PDF option if you want a PDF.

All analysis stays in this browser. There are no uploads, store connections,
accounts, subscriptions, tracking scripts or automatic saves. No store data is
changed. Keep a catalog backup and test a small import independently.

The comparison assumes overwrite of matching handles. Missing variants do not
prove deletion. Store rules, apps, metafields, market prices and image URL
availability are not checked. Unsupported columns are listed in the report.
Each input is limited to 8 MB and 10,000 data rows. Use UTF-8 comma-separated CSV.

The ZIP is optimized for desktop browsers. Local-file opening and download flows
can differ on phones; use the hosted preview if your phone blocks local HTML.
This is an evaluation prototype, with no verified sales or importer certification.
Independent tool. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Shopify.
